svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Fault journal record and ring
svg.desc: Layout of the 32-byte fault journal record in four rows of eight bytes, from the magic and version to the CRC-32, and a ring of eight slots in which the next append overwrites the oldest record.
svg.text: Ring of slots: the newest record is 5, the next append overwrites slot 6
